rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the process or result of comparing things.

example.english: This report contains a comparison of the two companies, and it looks clear.
example.traditional: 呢份報告入面有兩間公司嘅比較，睇落好清楚。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 jau5 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 bei2 gaau3 tai2 lok6 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when the comparison emphasizes the contrast between two things.

example.english: The comparison between red and black is very striking.
example.traditional: 紅色同黑色嘅對比好強烈。
example.jyutping: hung4 sik1 tung4 hak1 sik1 ge3 deoi3 bei2 hou2 koeng4 lit6

rows.note: Use this noun phrase to say that two things cannot meaningfully be compared or are not on the same level.

example.english: There is basically no comparison between designer sneakers and street-stall shoes.
example.traditional: 名牌波鞋同地攤貨根本冇可比性。
example.jyutping: ming4 paai4 bo1 haai4 tung4 dei6 taan1 fo3 gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 bei2 sing3
